artists.source_line: ✈️ A unique trip to beautiful Angola with accommodation and half board provided, organized by Jacinto Teca Events.

features.rationale: The package that includes the trip lists accommodation for 14 nights under 'Package INCLUDES'.

features.quote: half board (breakfast, one warm food -lunch or dinner plus non alcoholic drinks during meals)
features.rationale: Half board meals are listed as part of the package that includes the trip.

features.quote: private bus & transport to all activities
features.rationale: The package includes a private bus and transport to all activities, which is a shuttle service.
The description states that dance workshops are part of the trip.
The program includes concerts as part of the trip.
